cpu: AMD EPYC 9V74 virtual CPU; 5 vCPUs available to test process
memory_metric: Linux proportional set size (PSS) summed across the Chromium browser process and its child processes; RSS is also retained in raw data. PSS is a process-tree estimate, not a measurement of Firefox on the target laptop.
notes: Test container is not the user's Intel i3/8 GB target system; no claim of target-machine FPS is made.
No headless requestAnimationFrame metric is marketed as physical-touchpad frame rate.
30,000 paragraphs at 4x CPU throttle did not complete within the automation time budget and is explicitly inconclusive.
test_notes: The release branding changes the visible product name to Shadow Reader. Existing localStorage keys were deliberately retained so existing reading progress and preferences remain discoverable.

The final regression run passed parser, resume/progress, Focus Here, server API, virtualization browser smoke, touchpad scroll, Focus Here browser, and resume browser checks. One earlier combined shell command timed out at its final browser test; that same resume browser test was rerun individually and passed.
Headless Chromium results are not equivalent to physical touchpad or native Firefox GUI measurements. No FPS uplift is claimed.
